text: PhD defended at the University of Bologna (Health and Technologies), evaluated Excellent cum laude. Supervisor: Prof. Gastone Castellani.

Started as a Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of Bologna, continuing work on machine learning for clinical microbiology and omics data within the Physics4MedicineLab with Prof. Gastone Castellani.
MaldiSuite ecosystem published on PyPI - MaldiAMRKit, MaldiBatchKit, and MaldiDeepKit for end-to-end clinical AMR pipelines.
Poster at ESCMID Global 2026, Munich (17-21 April): 'AMRchitecture - a standardised benchmark framework for MALDI-TOF-based antimicrobial resistance detection'.
Started as an Associate Researcher at IRCCS Policlinico di Sant'Orsola (Azienda Ospedaliero-Universitaria di Bologna) with Dr. Magda Ialonardi.
Paper published in BMC Microbiology - multicentre AMR prediction in Klebsiella pneumoniae from MALDI-TOF spectra.
ResPredAI released on PyPI - CLI-based ML framework for predicting resistances in Gram-negative bloodstream infections.
Completed 6-month research visit at the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry, Munich (March-September 2025) - Machine Learning & Systems Biology group (Prof. Karsten Borgwardt).
Paper published in Scientific Reports - evolutionary dynamics of Monkeypox virus through less explored pathways.
Paper published in npj Digital Medicine - AI model to predict resistances in Gram-negative bloodstream infections.
